About Organization

The Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC) is a government organization responsible for conducting exams and selecting candidates for various government jobs in Uttar Pradesh, India.
The organization aims to provide a fair and transparent selection process for candidates.

About the Programme

The UPSSSC PET 2026 is a preliminary examination test conducted by the Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Service Selection Commission (UPSSSC).
The exam is designed to select candidates for various government jobs in Uttar Pradesh, India.
